name: Gentleman
overview: The biblical concept of a 'Gentleman' can be understood through the lens of humility, honor, and faithfulness as seen in the lives of men like Abraham and John the Baptist. Abraham's obedience to God's commands, such as circumcising his household (Genesis 17:23), and the humble spirit upheld by honor rather than pride (Proverbs 29:23), highlight a godly character marked by submission to God's will. Furthermore, the greatness of John the Baptist, despite his humble standing, points to true honor being found in the kingdom of heaven rather than worldly status (Matthew 11:11). This understanding is grounded in the faithfulness to God's promises and prophetic fulfillment, as seen in the lineage and birth of Christ (Genesis 16:15; Matthew 1:18; Deuteronomy 18:18).
